units.text: The Yekaterinburg City Duma, expressing the interests of the residents of the City of Yekaterinburg, conscious of its responsibility for organizing city life, respecting Yekaterinburg’s historical and cultural traditions, and guided by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal and oblast laws and other regulatory legal acts governing the exercise of local self-government in the Russian Federation, adopts this Charter governing the organization of local self-government in the Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”.

units.locator: Article 1. City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 1. City of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: The City of Yekaterinburg, founded in 1723, forms part of Sverdlovsk Oblast and, in accordance with its Charter, is the administrative centre of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Art. 1 · “The City of Yekaterinburg, founded in 1723, forms part of…”

units.locator: Article 1. City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: The second paragraph was repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 22.11.2022 No. 57/81.
units.label: Art. 1 · “The second paragraph was repealed by Decision of the…”

units.locator: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.label: Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1. In accordance with federal and oblast legislation, the Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” is an urban okrug.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 2. The name of the municipality is the Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”. The abbreviated name of the municipality is the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 3. In the official symbols of the Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”, municipal legal acts and other cases requiring the name of the municipality to be stated, the abbreviated name may be used on an equal basis with the name defined in the first paragraph of point 2 of this Article.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Urban Okrug Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 4. For the purposes of this Charter, the terms “Urban Okrug Municipality ‘City of Yekaterinburg’”, “Municipality ‘City of Yekaterinburg’” and “municipality” are used as equivalent terms.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 3. Territory of the municipality
units.text: Article 3. Territory of the municipality
units.label: Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Territory of the municipality
units.text: 1. The territory of the municipality consists of settlement land, adjoining land for common use, recreational land and land for the development of the municipality.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Territory of the municipality
units.text: 2. The municipality comprises the following settlements: the City of Yekaterinburg; the settlements of Berezit, Zelyony Bor, Istok, Medny, Michurinsky, Moskovsky, Palkinsky Torfyanik, Polevodstvo, Sadovy, Severka, Sovkhozny, Sysert, Chusovskoye Ozero, Shabrovsky, Shirokaya Rechka and Shuvakish; and the villages of Verkhnemakarovo and Gorny Shchit.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Territory of the municipality
units.text: 3. For administrative purposes, the territory of the municipality is divided into 8 administrative-territorial units — city districts: Akademichesky, Verkh-Isetsky, Zheleznodorozhny, Kirovsky, Leninsky, Oktyabrsky, Ordzhonikidzevsky and Chkalovsky.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Territory of the municipality
units.text: A city district is not a municipality.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 3 · “A city district is not a municipality.”

units.locator: Article 4. Boundaries of the municipality
units.text: Article 4. Boundaries of the municipality
units.label: Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Boundaries of the municipality
units.text: 1. The boundaries of the municipality are established by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Boundaries of the municipality
units.text: 2. The boundaries of the municipality are changed by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast on the initiative of the population, local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”, state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast or federal state authorities, in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Boundaries of the municipality
units.text: 3. A change to the boundaries of the municipality that transfers the territories of individual settlements within it to the territories of other municipalities is carried out with the consent of the population of the municipality, expressed by the Yekaterinburg City Duma in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.label: Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1. The population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” consists of citizens of the Russian Federation residing in its territory on the grounds established by applicable legislation. The population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” may, in accordance with the procedure established by law, exercise local self-government through local referendums, municipal elections and other forms of direct expression of will, and through the Yekaterinburg City Duma, the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1-1. The population residing in the territory of the municipality and united by common interests in addressing matters of local significance constitutes the local community.
units.label: Point 1-1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 2. In accordance with federal legislation, foreign citizens permanently residing in the territory of the municipality have the right, on the basis of international treaties of the Russian Federation and in accordance with the established procedure, to elect and be elected to local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” and to participate in a local referendum.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Population of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 3. Foreign citizens permanently or predominantly residing in the territory of the municipality have the right, in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation, to exercise local self-government in other forms established by federal law.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.label: Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1. The representative body of the municipality is the Yekaterinburg City Duma (hereinafter referred to as the City Duma).
units.label: Point 1 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 2. The highest official of the municipality is the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 3. The executive and administrative body of the municipality is the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 4. The control and accounts body of the municipality is the Chamber of Accounts of the City of Yekaterinburg (hereinafter referred to as the Chamber of Accounts).
units.label: Point 4 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.label: Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1. The Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” has official symbols, the regulations on which are approved by decisions of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 2. Official symbols are subject to state registration in accordance with the procedure established by federal legislation.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 3. The procedure for using official symbols is established by a decision of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Official symbols of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 4. By a decision of the City Duma on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg, honorary titles and badges may be established for merits that have received broad recognition among the population of the municipality.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 7

units.text: Chapter II. COMPETENCE OF THE MUNICIPALITY

units.text: “CITY OF YEKATERINBURG”

units.locator: Article 8. Competence of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Article 8. Competence of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.label: Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Competence of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: The competence of the municipality consists of matters of local significance of the municipality; the powers of local self-government bodies and officials to address such matters and exercise individual state powers transferred by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast; and the rights of the municipality’s local self-government bodies to address matters not classified as matters of local significance of the municipality.
units.label: Art. 8 · text

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.label: Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 1. Matters of local significance are matters directly supporting the daily life of the population of the municipality, which, in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal legislation, are addressed independently by the population and/or local self-government bodies of the municipality.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 2. Matters of local significance of the municipality include:
units.label: Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 1) comprehensive socioeconomic development of the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 2) preparing and considering the draft municipal budget, approving and executing the municipal budget, monitoring its execution, and preparing and approving the report on execution of the municipal budget;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 3) introducing, amending and abolishing the municipality’s local taxes and levies;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 4) possession, use and disposal of municipally owned property;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 5) organizing electricity, heat, gas and water supply, wastewater disposal and fuel supply for the population within the municipality’s boundaries, within the powers established by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 5-1) exercising municipal oversight of the unified heat supply organization’s fulfilment of obligations to construct, reconstruct and/or modernize heat supply facilities;
units.label: Subpoint 5-1 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 6) road activities in relation to roads of local significance within the municipality’s boundaries and ensuring road traffic safety on them, including establishing and maintaining the operation of parking facilities (parking spaces); exercising municipal oversight of road transport, urban surface electric transport and road infrastructure within the municipality’s boundaries; organizing road traffic; and exercising other powers concerning the use of roads and road activities in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 7) providing housing to low-income citizens residing in the municipality who need residential premises; organizing the construction and maintenance of municipal housing stock; creating conditions for housing construction; exercising municipal housing oversight and other powers of local self-government bodies in accordance with housing legislation;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 8) creating conditions for providing transport services to the population and organizing transport services for the population within the municipality’s boundaries;
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 8-1) participating in the prevention of terrorism and extremism and in minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of manifestations of terrorism and extremism within the municipality’s boundaries;
units.label: Subpoint 8-1 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 8-2) developing and implementing measures aimed at strengthening interethnic and interfaith harmony, supporting and developing the languages and cultures of the peoples of the Russian Federation residing in the municipality, realizing the rights of indigenous small-numbered peoples and other national minorities, ensuring migrants’ social and cultural adaptation, and preventing conflicts between nationalities (ethnic groups);
units.label: Subpoint 8-2 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 9) participating in the prevention of emergencies and elimination of their consequences within the municipality’s boundaries;
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 10) organizing the maintenance of public order in the municipality’s territory by the municipal militia;
units.label: Subpoint 10 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 10-1) providing premises for an officer holding the position of district police commissioner to work in the administrative precinct of the municipality served by that officer;
units.label: Subpoint 10-1 Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 10-2) until 1 January 2017, providing housing to an officer holding the position of district police commissioner and the officer’s family members for the period during which the officer performs the duties of that position;
units.label: Subpoint 10-2 Point 2 Art. 9
